- GET /api/companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId/{update-status,files} —
  proxy to sidecar (filesystem reads).
- POST /api/companies/:companyId/skills — proxy to sidecar (creates files).
- PATCH /api/companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId/files — proxy to sidecar.
- DELETE /api/companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId — proxy to sidecar.
- POST /api/companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId/install-update — proxy.
- POST /api/instance/database-backups — proxy to sidecar (pg_dump host-only).
